title: Open the builder from the Builder page
prompt:
Story 1: Open the builder from the Builder page

- **Story**: XXX-open-builder
- **Created**: 2026-11-07
- **Status**: Draft
- **Demo**: choose Builder in the menu, read the page, press "Open the builder", and see the menu shrink and the folder tree open with its
  four folders and an empty middle; go to another page and come back.

## Story

As a team member, I want to reach the builder from the Builder page and have the folder structure of my project open, so that I can see
where my project's documents live before I do anything with them.

## Acceptance tests

The Builder page

- [ ] **Given** a project, **When** the user chooses "Builder" in the menu, **Then** the item is the selected one, the header reads
  "<project> / Builder", and the page shows the Builder icon, the title "Builder" and the description "Turn intent into working software,
  one guided step at a time."
- [ ] **Given** the page, **Then** three numbered cards show side by side on a wide screen (one under the other on a narrow one):
  "1 Prompt: Describe what a user needs in plain language, like a chat.", "2 Story: Claude drafts a user story with acceptance tests, and
  BWYN creates its folder once you approve.", and "3 Link: Connect the story to drivers, ADRs and architectural enablers."
- [ ] **Given** the page, **Then** under them a card "Start a new build" says "Prompt your way to a new story, or to an architectural
  enabler." and has a button "Open the builder" with an arrow.
- [ ] **Given** the application starts, or a project is created, **Then** the Builder page is shown with the workspace closed.
- [ ] **Given** the page, **Then** it can be read with no model connected and no repository connected.

Opening the builder

- [ ] **Given** the page, **When** the user presses "Open the builder", **Then** the main menu shrinks to a rail of icons (each item keeps
  its icon, its name as a tooltip and the selected mark), the page is replaced by the workspace, and the header reads
  "<project> / Builder / Files".
- [ ] **Given** the workspace, **Then** on the left a tree titled "Files", with the project name under it, shows four folders in this order:
  `drivers`, `adrs`, `architectural-enablers`, `stories`. Each has a chevron and a folder icon, and they are all closed.
- [ ] **Given** the workspace with no file open, **Then** the rest of the area shows a centred message, "Select a file in the tree to read
  it.", with no prompt box and no "New story" button.
- [ ] **Given** the rail, **When** the user presses the project's avatar or "Expand menu", **Then** the menu is full again and the workspace
  stays open. **When** the user presses "Collapse menu", **Then** the rail is back.
- [ ] **Given** the keyboard, **Then** "Open the builder", every menu item and every row of the tree can be reached with Tab, and a visible
  focus ring shows where the focus is.

Going away and coming back

- [ ] **Given** the workspace, **When** the user chooses another item of the menu (not Settings), **Then** the workspace closes, the menu is
  full, and that page shows. **When** the user chooses "Builder" again, **Then** the Builder page shows, with the workspace closed.
- [ ] **Given** the workspace, **When** the user chooses "Builder" in the menu, **Then** the workspace stays open.
- [ ] **Given** the workspace, **When** the user chooses another project, **Then** the workspace shows that project's tree, with every
  folder closed and no file open.
- [ ] **Given** the workspace, **When** the page is reloaded, **Then** the Builder page shows with the workspace closed.

## Business rules and constraints

- The structure of the tree is fixed: four folders, in the order `drivers`, `adrs`, `architectural-enablers`, `stories`, and no other. Their
  names are the names of the folders of the repository.
- The workspace belongs to the project, and is shown again from the start for each project and each time it is opened.
- The workspace has no prompt in these stories. The cards of the page describe the whole builder, which the stories that come later build.
- Everything is reachable by keyboard.

## Out of scope

- The prompt, "New story", the runway diagram, and everything that belongs to stories and architectural enablers.
- What is inside the folders and opening files (stories 2 to 4).
- The menu and the project selector (`story-navigation-and-menu-bar.md`), and Settings.

## Tasks

- [ ] Build the Builder page: the three steps from a list, the card "Start a new build", and the button.
- [ ] Keep, in the app, whether the workspace is open, and close it when another item of the menu is chosen.
- [ ] Collapse the main menu when the workspace opens, with the rail, the expand and collapse buttons, and the breadcrumb "Files" segment.
- [ ] Build the workspace frame: the tree on the left (four closed folders, the title and the project name) and the empty state.
- [ ] Draw the workspace again from the start for each project.
- [ ] Take the prompt, the "New story" button and the runway button out of the workspace and the tree header.

tasks.text: Add a `BuilderViewModel` in the interface-adapters layer that holds `isWorkspaceOpen: boolean` and exposes `openWorkspace()` and `closeWorkspace()` commands, with a Jest unit test (ADR-0007, Architecture)
Bind `BuilderViewModel` in the Inversify composition root (ADR-0006)

Build the `BuilderPage` React component in the UI layer: Builder icon, title, description, three numbered step cards (responsive layout), and the "Start a new build" card with the "Open the builder" button; wire it to `BuilderViewModel.openWorkspace()` (ADR-0007)

Build the `BuilderWorkspace` React component in the UI layer: the file tree (title "Files", project name, four closed folders with chevrons) and the empty-state message "Select a file in the tree to read it." (ADR-0007)

Implement menu-rail mode in the existing menu component: when `isWorkspaceOpen` is true, collapse to icon-only rail with tooltips and selected mark; expose "Expand menu" / "Collapse menu" controls (ADR-0020, Architecture)
Update the breadcrumb in the UI layer to append "/ Files" when the workspace is open (ADR-0007)

Wire navigation so that choosing any non-Builder menu item calls `closeWorkspace()` and navigating back to Builder shows the page with the workspace closed; choosing Builder while the workspace is open leaves it open (ADR-0020)
Reset workspace state to closed on project switch and on page reload (ADR-0007)
Add keyboard focus management: verify Tab order reaches "Open the builder", every menu item, and every tree row; add visible focus rings where missing (Architecture)
Write Jest rendering tests for `BuilderPage` and `BuilderWorkspace` covering the acceptance tests above (ADR-0005)
Confirm ArchUnitTS rules still pass with the new files in place (ADR-0016)
Verify the full frontend build and test suite completes within the ten-minute budget (Practice: Ten-Minute Build)
